status: M2a: control plane + format + settings + heartbeat (all additive); effect/voice/audio-plane/shm sections land M2b/M3

framing.stdout-discipline: child stdout is protocol-only; all logging goes through the log.write notification, stderr is captured by the host for diagnostics

jsonrpc.ids: opaque strings (host uses GUID-n); notifications carry no id

environment.TUNELAB_PROTOCOL: wire version the host speaks; child must refuse handshake otherwise

initialize.notes: every host-declared format entry MUST be answered in provides; a missing one is a protocol violation and the host kills the child

params.stream_ref: absolute path of a temp file holding the source bytes

format.import.temp-files: under <TuneLabFolder>/Temp/io-<nonce>/; host deletes after the call; the child must not outlive them

params.stream_ref: absolute path the sidecar must write the exported bytes to

format.export.notes: host owns the final output stream and copies stream_ref into it atomically

ping.notes: heartbeat: host pings every 15s with a 5s timeout; 4 consecutive failures = wedged sidecar, host kills the tree (facades MUST keep the RPC loop responsive — run user code on worker threads)

settings.get_config.notes: schema for the extension settings panel (manifest entry field "settings": true); must work BEFORE engine init; declared ONLY by entries that have settings

settings.apply.shape: notification while running; also delivered as initialize.params.entries[].settings (key 'settings') when the host holds values before (re)spawn
settings.apply.notes: password fields are decrypted host-side before delivery — same trust level as an in-process plugin's ApplySettings

value-encoding.naming: property names camelCase; public fields included (Point.X/Y); enums as camelCase strings, numbers accepted on read

property-value.nan-or-infinity: NEVER a bare JSON token — always the strings "NaN"|"Infinity"|"-Infinity" (inside n payloads and for any plain double field alike; legal JSON, host reads all forms, writers MUST write strings)
property-value.reading-plain-values: readers MAY accept untagged JSON natives (bool/number/string/array/object); bare objects under a properties map with exactly one reserved key b|n|s|o|a of matching value kind are treated as tagged — authors who need such single-underscore-free literal maps as property objects must nest them under another key

value-encoding.property-object: JSON object of tagged values; appears at key "properties" inside notes/parts/effects/projects trees

config.note: controller configs are factory-built on the host side; the wire carries DECLARATIONS only — custom INormalizedScale/INumberFormat/IDragResponse lambdas cannot cross (host codec throws on unknown kinds)

lifecycle.parent-death: child MUST exit on stdin EOF (all platforms) and additionally arm OS-level guards: Windows host-side Job Object, Linux PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, macOS ppid poll — all inside the facade/host
lifecycle.crash: host discards the process generation (epoch++), fails the in-flight calls with runtime_error, respawns on the next call with backoff; 5 deaths in 10 minutes open the circuit
lifecycle.progress-events-settings: reserved for M2/M3 method groups; unknown notifications MUST be ignored by both sides (forward compatibility)
